title: Trust and emotional safety
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What makes people feel safe with you?
Jose said that trust is a big part of leadership, and that as a leader you want to create a trust pattern. He said that safety is saying: I will make sure that you are very successful no matter what.
Jose said that his emotional safety is always intact, whatever the circumstances, even in a hostile environment.
A student said that in their company they set a goal and made it the success or failure line, even though they made it up in their heads.
Jose said that the trick is creating patterns where you are not stuck in winning or losing, so that you break the pattern of we failed.

He said that after every meeting people say what a fun and pleasant person that was, and he has a pattern of creating and controlling his communication that is always consistent. This is his own account.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the sentence that says people are safe with you.
Write the line you drew for success and failure.
Write how you break a win or lose pattern.
Write what stays intact in you under pressure.

check.q: What did Jose say is a big part of leadership?
What did Jose say he is not stuck in?
What did a student say about a success line?
choices: They made it up in their heads
It was set by a bank

recap: Create trust. Keep your own safety. Break win-or-lose.
